questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which hydrocarbon is included in the alkane group?
questions.explanation: Methane has only single bonds. So it belongs to the alkane group.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which one is the correct formula of glycerol?
questions.explanation: Glycerol has three -OH groups. Its formula is C3H5(OH)3.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which is the IUPAC name of the alcohol used as a beverage?
questions.explanation: The alcohol used in beverages is ethyl alcohol. Its IUPAC name is ethanol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which of the following is used to protect skin from dryness?
questions.explanation: Glycerol holds moisture. So it helps protect skin from dryness.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which hydrocarbon is used to prepare glycerol?
questions.explanation: Glycerol has three carbon atoms like propane. So propane is used to prepare glycerol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What are hydrocarbons?
options: Compounds of calcium and oxygen only
Compounds of metals and ores only
questions.explanation: Hydrocarbons contain only carbon and hydrogen. So they are compounds of carbon and hydrogen.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which hydrocarbon has the formula CH4?
questions.explanation: CH4 has one carbon atom and four hydrogen atoms. This hydrocarbon is methane.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which hydrocarbon has the formula C2H6?
questions.explanation: C2H6 has two carbon atoms and six hydrogen atoms. This hydrocarbon is ethane.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which hydrocarbon has the formula C3H8?
questions.explanation: C3H8 has three carbon atoms and eight hydrogen atoms. This hydrocarbon is propane.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which hydrocarbon has the formula C2H4?
questions.explanation: C2H4 has two carbon atoms and four hydrogen atoms. This hydrocarbon is ethene.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which hydrocarbon has the formula C2H2?
questions.explanation: C2H2 is the formula of ethyne. Ethyne is also called acetylene.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which group contains hydrocarbons with single bonds only?
questions.explanation: Alkanes have only single bonds between carbon atoms. So they are saturated hydrocarbons.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which group contains at least one double bond?
questions.explanation: Alkenes have at least one double bond. This makes them unsaturated hydrocarbons.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which group contains at least one triple bond?
questions.explanation: Alkynes have at least one triple bond. Acetylene is an example of an alkyne.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is the functional group of alcohols?
questions.explanation: Alcohols contain the hydroxyl group. The hydroxyl group is written as -OH.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which alcohol is known as methyl alcohol?
questions.explanation: Methyl alcohol is the common name of methanol. So methanol is the answer.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which alcohol is known as ethyl alcohol?
questions.explanation: Ethyl alcohol is the common name of ethanol. So ethanol is the answer.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which type of alcohol contains one hydroxyl group?
questions.explanation: Mono means one and hydric means -OH group. Monohydric alcohol has one hydroxyl group.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which type of alcohol contains three hydroxyl groups?
questions.explanation: Tri means three. Trihydric alcohol has three hydroxyl groups.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which compound is a trihydric alcohol?
questions.explanation: Glycerol has three -OH groups. So it is a trihydric alcohol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is ethane called a saturated hydrocarbon?
options: It has only single covalent bonds between carbon atoms.
questions.explanation: Ethane has only single carbon-carbon bonds. So it is a saturated hydrocarbon.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is glycerol called a trihydric alcohol?
options: It is a gas used in refrigerators.
questions.explanation: Glycerol contains three hydroxyl groups. So it is called trihydric alcohol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which general formula is used for alkanes?
questions.explanation: Alkanes have the general formula CnH2n+2. Methane and ethane follow this formula.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which general formula is used for alkenes?
questions.explanation: Alkenes have one double bond. Their general formula is CnH2n.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which general formula is used for alkynes?
questions.explanation: Alkynes have one triple bond. Their general formula is CnH2n-2.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which pair is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: Methane has the formula CH4. So this pair is correct.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which pair is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: Ethanol has the formula C2H5OH. So this pair is correct.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which compound is formed when one hydrogen atom of ethane is replaced by -OH?
questions.explanation: Replacing one hydrogen of ethane by -OH gives ethanol. Ethanol is an alcohol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which compound is formed by replacing three hydrogen atoms of propane with three -OH groups?
questions.explanation: Replacing three hydrogen atoms of propane by three -OH groups gives glycerol. So glycerol has three -OH groups.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is the IUPAC name of glycerol?
questions.explanation: Glycerol has three -OH groups on propane. Its IUPAC name is propane-1,2,3-triol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which compound is used as a sweetening agent in food according to the chapter?
questions.explanation: Glycerol has a sweet taste. So it is used as a sweetening agent in food.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which compound is used in good quality soap, lotion, cosmetics and shaving creams?
questions.explanation: Glycerol keeps moisture and makes products smooth. So it is used in soap, lotion and cosmetics.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which compound helps keep tobacco moist and prevents dryness of foods?
questions.explanation: Glycerol holds water and prevents drying. So it keeps tobacco and some foods moist.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which alcohol is used to prepare formaldehyde?
questions.explanation: Methanol is used to prepare formaldehyde. That is one important use of methanol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which alcohol is used in alcoholic beverages?
questions.explanation: Ethanol is the alcohol present in alcoholic beverages. So beverages use ethanol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which alcohol is used in spirit lamps?
questions.explanation: Methanol burns easily. So it is used in spirit lamps.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which statement best distinguishes saturated and unsaturated hydrocarbons?
options: Saturated hydrocarbons have single bonds; unsaturated hydrocarbons have double or triple bonds.
questions.explanation: Saturated hydrocarbons have only single bonds. Unsaturated hydrocarbons have double or triple bonds.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which statement best distinguishes alkane and alkene?
options: Alkanes have single bonds; alkenes have double bonds.
Alkanes have triple bonds; alkenes are alcohols.
questions.explanation: Alkanes have single bonds. Alkenes have at least one double bond.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which statement best distinguishes monohydric and trihydric alcohol?
options: They differ in number of hydroxyl groups.
questions.explanation: Monohydric alcohol has one -OH group. Trihydric alcohol has three -OH groups.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which term means a series of organic compounds with similar chemical properties and a difference of CH2 between successive members?
questions.explanation: A homologous series has similar compounds. Consecutive members differ by CH2.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: A hydrocarbon has the structural formula H-C-C-H with only single bonds and the remaining valencies filled by H. Which compound is represented?
questions.explanation: Two carbon atoms with only single bonds form ethane. The remaining valencies are filled by hydrogen atoms.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: If one hydrogen atom in ethane is replaced by an -OH group, which compound is formed?
questions.explanation: Ethane becomes ethanol when one hydrogen is replaced by -OH. This forms an alcohol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is the bond between carbon atoms in ethene weaker than a single C-C bond?
options: It contains a double bond with a pi bond that is more reactive.
questions.explanation: Ethene has a double bond. The pi bond in the double bond is more reactive and weaker.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which set contains only unsaturated hydrocarbons?
questions.explanation: Ethene, propene and acetylene have double or triple bonds. So they are unsaturated hydrocarbons.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which set contains only saturated hydrocarbons?
questions.explanation: Methane, ethane and propane have only single bonds. So they are saturated hydrocarbons.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which formula-name pair is correct?
questions.explanation: Propyne has three carbon atoms and one triple bond. Its formula is C3H4.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which formula-name pair is correct?
questions.explanation: Butane is an alkane with four carbon atoms. Its formula is C4H10.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: A student needs a compound to reduce dryness of skin. Which compound and IUPAC name are correct?
questions.explanation: Glycerol reduces skin dryness. Its IUPAC name is propane-1,2,3-triol.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which classification is correct for ethanol and glycerol?
options: Ethanol is monohydric; glycerol is trihydric.
Ethanol is trihydric; glycerol is alkane.
questions.explanation: Ethanol has one -OH group, so it is monohydric. Glycerol has three -OH groups, so it is trihydric.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which answer best explains why hydrocarbons form many homologous series?
options: Carbon forms chains and members differ regularly by CH2.
Hydrocarbons are made from soap only.
questions.explanation: Carbon atoms can join to make long chains. In a homologous series, each next member differs by CH2.
